In different ways, these four examples highlight some of the limits of TFL, symbolization of English in TFL, and the tests based on truth tables we’ve devised. Our first example showed that TFL is not expressive enough to symbolize everything we might want to in a way that allows us to apply our logical toolkit to even the best possible symbolization.
